note: Pinned tracker and cookie lists, each at a git commit of its GitHub repository (raw.githubusercontent.com/<repo>/<ref>/<path> never changes). fetch_lists.py downloads them to a cache outside the repository and fails if a hash differs; --update pins each branch's latest commit (--write-lock writes the new lock elsewhere). The lists are not committed: EasyPrivacy is GPL-3.0-or-later / CC BY-SA 3.0, the Open Cookie Database Apache-2.0. EasyPrivacy's built list is committed to the gh-pages branch of easylist/easylist; easylist.to serves the same file but rebuilds it several times a day.
